intent: PSI-006: expose the agent-ops scripts as package.json commands (obsidian:sync, obsidian:watch, agent:context, agent:check) and prove each clause of the accept line by running it.
summary: PSI-006 was picked because PSI-002 (the natural next task) was already claimed and being edited by another agent session in the main working tree (branch task/PSI-002, about 98 uncommitted files, no history entry yet). To avoid two agents in one folder (C-03) this work ran in its own git worktree at D:/coding/pflp/p3md-psi-006 on branch task/PSI-006, based on ba1919f. The two scripts and the ajv/ajv-formats dev dependencies already existed from PSI-003 and PSI-001, so the only code change is four scripts in the root package.json. Every clause of the accept line was then run and passed: sync writes Board.md with the kanban-plugin header; agent:check exits 1 when .hermes.md is missing, 1 when it is stale (after editing README_AI_AGENT.md), 1 on a schema-invalid history entry, and 0 once everything is current; obsidian:watch redrew the board 409 ms after the task list was saved. Claimed in docs/list-task-project.md (status doing, owner agent:claude-code) in both working trees so the Obsidian board shows it in Doing; set to review at the end. Nothing pushed.

changes.note: Added scripts obsidian:sync, obsidian:watch, agent:context, agent:check (exactly as docs/integrated-obsidian-local.md section 4)

decisions.decision: Work in a separate git worktree (task/PSI-006) instead of the main folder
decisions.reason: Another agent session owns PSI-002 and has uncommitted edits in the main tree; switching branches or committing there would disturb it
alternatives: Wait for the PSI-002 session to finish
Take over PSI-002 in the shared tree

decisions.decision: Change only package.json; leave the two scripts as they are
decisions.reason: They already met the accept line when run. A ponytail review suggested shrinking scripts/agent-context.ts, but the accept line and contract C-16 require agent-context --check, so it stays
alternatives: Replace agent-context.ts with a one-line cat script

decisions.decision: Edit only the PSI-006 lines of docs/list-task-project.md in the main tree as well
decisions.reason: The operator's Obsidian vault is built from the main tree, so the claim only shows on their Kanban board if the file there says doing
alternatives: Edit only the worktree copy and let the board update after merge

verification.manual: In the worktree, bun install then: obsidian:sync exit 0 and Board.md starts with kanban-plugin: board; agent:check with no .hermes.md exit 1; agent:context wrote .hermes.md (11,620 characters, contract only); agent:check exit 0; after appending a line to README_AI_AGENT.md agent:check exit 1 ('stale'); after adding a schema-invalid entry file agent:check exit 1 ('must have required property agent, session, intent, outcome'); after removing it exit 0; obsidian:watch redrew Board.md 409 ms after saving docs/list-task-project.md and again after restoring it. All probe edits were reverted (git diff shows only the intended changes). bun is not installed globally; commands were run as npx bun run <script>.

risks: Merge conflict expected in docs/list-task-project.md: the main tree carries an uncommitted 'PSI-006 doing' edit that the PSI-002 branch may commit; resolve by keeping PSI-006 at review (or done once a human approves)
agent:check needs .hermes.md, which is gitignored: on a fresh clone or CI run agent:context first, otherwise check fails as 'missing'
There is no AGENTS.md at the repo root (only frontend-architecture/AGENTS.md), so .hermes.md holds only the contract until PSI-004 wires it
The package.json scripts call bun; plain npm run fails unless bun is on PATH
A history entry written with a UTF-8 BOM (PowerShell Set-Content -Encoding utf8) is rejected as invalid JSON

follow_ups.note: Put AGENTS.md at the repo root or point agent-context at frontend-architecture/AGENTS.md, then re-run agent:context; today .hermes.md has no shared conventions
Now unblocked: add the Husky pre-commit that runs bun run agent:check (remember agent:context must run first or .hermes.md is generated in the hook)
The session working on PSI-002 must write its own history entry (C-13/C-16); at the time of this entry none existed
Install bun globally (or document npx bun) so agent commands work exactly as the docs list them

human_review.reason: Normal review before merge; also decide how to merge task/PSI-006 next to task/PSI-002, which both touch docs/list-task-project.md
